name: v1.0.0
body:
## What's Changed
* feat(database): add FeedService for managing feeds by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/1
* ci: run ESLint, Prettier, and tests on commit, push, and PR by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/2
* chore(deps-dev): bump eslint-plugin-react-refresh from 0.4.26 to 0.5.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/3
* chore(deps-dev): bump the dev-deps group across 1 directory with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/9
* feat(feed): add feedSyncService and articleService for saving and syncing feeds by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/10
* chore(deps-dev): bump @isaacs/brace-expansion from 5.0.0 to 5.0.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/11
* refactor(feed): modularize feedParser and switch to absolute imports by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/12
* feat(feed): add dialog for user to create feed by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/15
* chore(deps): bump the prod-deps group with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/13
* chore(deps-dev): bump the dev-deps group across 1 directory with 7 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/17
* fix(ci): add --legacy-peer-deps to npm ci and update package-lock.json by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/19
* refactor(feed): move feed types to shared directory and merge parser modules by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/18
* fix(feed): resolve crash in normalizeFeed due to missing items array by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/20
* fix(feed): use handleDialogOpenChange to ensure cleanup when adding a feed by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/21
* feat(feed): parse summary to plain text by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/22
* fix(articles): fix error when saving articles by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/23
* refactor(parser): replace Feedsmith with rss-parser and update all references by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/26
* feat(feed): add error handling to feedParser and feedSyncService by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/27
* feat(articles): add articles list page by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/28
* fix(build): resolve production build and database initialization errors by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/31
* test: add missing tests for article service and feed parser by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/32
* fix(config): load environment variables from .env.test by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/33
* feat(ui): add dark mode by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/34
* chore(deps-dev): bump the dev-deps group across 1 directory with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/35
* chore(deps): bump the prod-deps group with 6 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/29
* feat(Articles): update ArticlesList and ArticleService by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/36
* feat(article): Add article page by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/38
* chore(deps-dev): bump tar from 7.5.7 to 7.5.9 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/37
* feat(dev): add react devtools by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/39
* fix(useScrollRestoration): remove debug console logs by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/40
* fix(test): update feed parser type in feed by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/42
* chore(deps-dev): bump ajv from 6.12.6 to 6.14.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/41
* feat(articles-list): record read status and add filter to the list by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/43
* refactor(articles): use Zustand for state management and remove ArticlesProvider by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/46
* chore(deps-dev): bump the dev-deps group with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/45
* chore(deps): bump the prod-deps group with 8 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/44
* refactor(articles): optimize list and detail page logic by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/47
* chore(deps): bump minimatch by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/48
* refactor(dataStorage): implement Zustand for data storage management and remove ThemeProvider by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/49
* fix(build): use FileSet instead of glob patterns to include files by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/50
* chore(deps): bump rollup from 4.57.0 to 4.59.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/51
* perf(articles-list): add virtualized list and pagination by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/56
* feat(fetching-status): Add fetching status by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/60
* chore(deps): bump the prod-deps group across 1 directory with 12 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/59
* chore(deps): bump dompurify from 3.3.1 to 3.3.2 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/58
* chore(deps-dev): bump tar from 7.5.9 to 7.5.10 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/55
* chore(deps-dev): bump the dev-deps group with 8 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/54
* chore(deps): bump undici from 7.22.0 to 7.24.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/61
* feat(article-media): enhance media support and optimize code blocks by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/74
* refactor(articles): add fetchArticles function and remove ref in ArticlesList by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/76
* chore(deps-dev): bump electron from 41.0.0 to 41.0.3 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/75
* feat(article): enhance article header with sticky controls by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/80
* chore(deps): bump lodash and prisma by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/77
* chore(deps-dev): bump electron from 41.0.3 to 41.1.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/78
* chore(deps): bump defu from 6.1.4 to 6.1.6 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/79
* feat(ArticlesList): move new feed button to list page and remove home page by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/81
* task: general updates by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/85
* chore(deps-dev): bump the dev-deps group across 1 directory with 5 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/87
* chore(deps): bump the prod-deps group across 1 directory with 4 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/86
* feat(Setting): Add setting page by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/89
* refactor(database): migrate from Prisma to Drizzle ORM  by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/92
* chore(deps-dev): bump the dev-deps group with 10 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/99
* chore(deps): bump the prod-deps group across 1 directory with 14 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/98
* feat(build): setup release workflow and fix production styling by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/112
* feat(app): Rename application to PaperDeck and update logo by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/113
* fix(feed): improve error handling and clean up IPC bridge by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/114
* chore(deps): bump the prod-deps group across 1 directory with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/117
* chore(deps-dev): bump the dev-deps group with 2 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/116
* docs: add README and LICENSE by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/118
* feat(window): focus existing window instead of opening a new one by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/119
* build(electron): migrate to electron-forge and implement auto-update by @prontLin in https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/pull/120

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/PaperDeck/PaperDeck/commits/v1.0.0
